title: Roster
description: One roster: a favourite team setup, named so it can be dispatched again without being rebuilt. A roster is roles information; a dispatch is an instance of it. Filed by name, recon.json.

kind.description: the word roster, which is what chooses this schema

name.description: the roster's name in lowercase with hyphens, the same name the file is named for; a roster carries a name, not an identifier

purpose.description: the kind of work this setup is for, in one line

seats.description: the seat names this roster calls for, a list matching crew dossiers

shape.description: how the seats are arranged and run, in one or two sentences

updated.description: the date the roster was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD
